properties.name: ROOT CAUSE (root-cause skill) 2026-10-18: the generalization check read only `fixes` and never the assumptions open at the step, so a generalization over F under an open hypothesis about F read holds (Arrow trial N19, a soundness defect)
properties.statement: ROOT CAUSE, walked with the root-cause skill, 2026-10-18. (1) OBSERVED: the Arrow trial (flo2.io 6308149cf93f7723, reflow2 0.86.0, round 1, observer note N19): a step generalizing over F while an undischarged hypothesis mentioned F read `holds`. Reproduced on main b32fe1adc: a hand-built step inf:generalize (generalizes_over [F]) resting on a conclusion drawn under the open assumption req:hyp-f (variables [F]), discharged only by a LATER step, read verdict holds with assumes [req:hyp-f], and the theorem above it read shown; and on the Arrow fixture with inf:theorem's discharges removed, inf:fe-moves (over G, x, y, z) read holds under the open req:fe-hyp-almost-decisive (variables F, G, x, y). Expected: not holds, by the eigenvariable rule of natural deduction (generalize over x only if x is free in no assumption still open). NOT affected: a generalization over a variable a premise `fixes` read unknown, as built. (2) SEARCHED reflow2's design and every hub member on the raw words: no precedent. (3) CANDIDATES from the bones: intent (the requirement stated only half of the rule); implementation (generalization_reading never read the step's open assumptions); assurance (no test put an open assumption beside a generalization); not in the component (the trial's designer wrote through create_nodes, skipping add_inference's refusals); the observation is wrong (the hypothesis was in fact discharged). (4-5) MEASURED: req:a-proof-can-discharge-an-assumption-and-generalize-over-a-variable says "reflow2 checks that no premise in the chain fixes them" and nothing about assumptions: confirmed. inference.rs generalization_reading computed holds = fixed_by.is_empty() over rests_on_closure, and Read.assumes (the open assumptions, already computed in step_reading) was never passed to it: confirmed. tests/a_proof_says_what_it_assumes.rs pinned only `fixes` cases (the induction case discharges on the generalizing step itself): confirmed. The route candidate is refuted: the verdict is computed on read, whatever wrote the step, and add_inference never checked generalization either. The wrong-observation candidate is refuted by the reproduction. (6) CLASS: the check transcribed one of the two conditions of ∀-introduction, the one the primes trial happened to exercise (a computation at one value), and the requirement, the code and the tests all followed that transcription; every generalization under an open assumption naming its variable was certified. (7) PINNED as a class, failing first on main: a_proof_states_what_it_really_does::a_generalization_does_not_hold_over_a_variable_an_open_assumption_names (every generalizing step of five trial fixtures, as they stand and with their discharges opened) and ::the_n19_shape_... both FAILED on b32fe1adc. (8) FIXED in feat/a-proof-states-what-it-really-does: a generalization over v does not hold while an assumption open at the step NAMES v (its `variables` or `fixes` lists v) or declares no `variables` (unanswerable); the step's own discharges close first. (9) NOT ESTABLISHED: which exact records the round-1 Arrow design held when N19 was seen (the committed fixture is its later state, where inf:theorem discharges the hypothesis on the generalizing step and reads correctly).
